_meta.policy: L1–L9 numeric RBAC is retired (M11 R1). Trust levels may appear only as human-readable template labels, not as authorization IDs.

mappings.label: Read-only / observer
mappings.replacement: Scoped read permissions on matter, document, deadline modules (no .decide gate permissions)

mappings.label: Partner delegate
mappings.replacement: Subset of tenant.responsible_partner gate permissions with branch scope

mappings.label: Practice lead
mappings.replacement: Named permissions in billguard + deadline gate catalogue for practice group scope

mappings.label: Kill-switch / platform ops (legacy wording)
mappings.replacement: engine.killswitch.* and ledger.break_glass.* named permissions with step_up_required

mappings.label: Super admin (retired — prohibited in demos)
mappings.replacement: Decomposed into scoped platform roles; no single super-admin permission
